source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Air Injection Reactor System, p.6T-4

procedures.title: A.I.R. pump filter: replace
notes: A new filter may squeal at first until its outer sealing lip wears in.

procedures.title: A.I.R. air manifold, hoses and tubes: inspect and replace
steps: Check all hoses for deterioration or holes and all tubes for cracks or holes (see figure 4 in the manual).
Check every hose and tube connection, and check routing; interference causes wear.
If a pressure-side leak is suspected, or pressure-side parts were disconnected, brush soapy water on the connections with the pump running; bubbles show leaks.
To replace, note the routing, remove the hoses and/or tubes, fit new ones routed the same way, and tighten all connections.
Use anti-seize compound on the threads where the air manifold meets the exhaust manifold (V8).
notes: CAUTION: the 1/4" pipe threads in the V8 exhaust manifold are straight pipe threads; do not run a 1/4" tapered pipe tap into them.
A.I.R. hoses are a special high-temperature material; do not substitute other hose.

procedures.title: A.I.R. check valve: inspect and replace
steps: Inspect whenever its hose is disconnected or failure is suspected; a dead pump with signs of exhaust gas inside points to a failed check valve.
Blow through the valve by mouth toward the air manifold, then try to suck back; air must flow only toward the manifold.
To replace, disconnect the pump outlet hose at the check valve and unscrew the valve from the air manifold without bending or twisting the manifold.

procedures.title: A.I.R. diverter valve: inspect and replace
steps: Check condition and routing of all lines, especially the signal line; all must be secure, unkinked and leak-free.
Disconnect the signal line at the valve; with the engine running there must be vacuum.
At steady idle no air should come from the muffler; snap the throttle open and shut and a blast of air should come out the muffler for at least 1 second.
Replace a defective valve: disconnect the vacuum signal line and the valve exhaust hose(s), remove the valve from the pump, and take the muffler off noting its angle.
Fit the muffler to the new valve at the same angle.
Mount the valve to the pump or bracket with a new gasket and torque the screws to 85 in. lbs.
Reconnect the outlet and vacuum signal lines and check for leaks.
notes: CAUTION: diverter valves that look alike are built for different engines; install the correct one.

procedures.title: A.I.R. air injection tubes: inspect and replace
steps: No routine service; on V8s, inspect the tubes whenever the exhaust manifolds are off for carbon buildup and warped or burned tubes (see figure 5 in the manual).
